deviations.description: Rule A is not implemented: no unit compares cov with cap (cap has only small positive weights). A request whose only problem is a coverage goal above the hot-spot cap (cov > cap) with no mandible conflict, an achievable cord goal and no missing structure gets a strongly negative score and goes to automated planning.
deviations.condition: (cov > cap) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim)) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and (missing == 0)
